caption: #Ad These nachos start with @Tostitos Mexican Street Corn Flavored Tortilla Chips and get piled high with the creamiest smoked Gouda cheese sauce and roasted sweet corn. It’s perfect appetizer for your next backyard get together and the best part it’s all done in the grill! You can also add ground beef to turn it into a meal.  🌽🧀 Backyard Elote Nachos Serves 8–10 ✨ 1 bag Tostitos® Mexican Street Corn Flavored Tortilla Chips ✨ 16 oz frozen sweet corn ✨ Freshly grated Parmesan cheese ✨ Crema ✨ Salsa Valentina ✨ Juice of 1 lime ✨ 1 avocado, diced ✨ Sliced jalapeños Cheese Sauce ✨ 10 oz smoked Gouda, cubed ✨ 10 oz Monterey Jack, cubed ✨ 8 oz cream cheese ✨ ½ cup evaporated milk ✨ 1 (10 oz) can diced tomatoes with green chiles ✨ 1 tsp garlic powder ✨ 1 tsp onion powder ✨ ½ tsp smoked paprika ✨ Instructions Add all of the cheese sauce ingredients to a grill-safe pan. Grill over medium heat with the lid closed, stirring every 3–4 minutes, until smooth and melted (about 15 minutes). Spread the Tostitos® Mexican Street Corn Flavored Tortilla Chips onto a large platter. Pour over the warm cheese sauce, then top with the roasted corn, Parmesan, crema, Salsa Valentina, fresh lime juice, avocado, and jalapeños. Enjoy!
